## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Saṅghādisesa 11, titled *Bhedānuvattaka* ("Siding with a schismatic"), is the eleventh training rule in the *saṅghādisesa* (formal suspension) chapter of the Pali *Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga*. The rule addresses monks who associate with and support a fellow monk attempting to instigate a schism (*saṅghabheda*) in the monastic community; persisting in such factional support despite formal admonition incurs the severe ecclesiastical penalty of suspension. The text has been translated into English by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
